summary: This note is a Wikipedia-style biography stub about James Reasoner, an American writer. It states he has written more than 350 novels and many short stories over a career of more than thirty years. It also lists the at least nineteen pseudonyms he has used and explains that many were house names for Western fiction series that other authors also wrote under.
one_line: American writer James Reasoner, author of 350+ novels across 30+ years and known for using at least nineteen pseudonyms.
key_facts: James Reasoner was born on 5 June 1953.
James Reasoner is an American writer.
James Reasoner has authored more than 350 novels.
Reasoner's career spans more than thirty years.
James Reasoner has used at least nineteen pseudonyms in addition to his own name.
One pseudonym of James Reasoner is Jim Austin.
One pseudonym of James Reasoner is Jake Logan.
One pseudonym of James Reasoner is Jon Sharpe.
James Reasoner used the pseudonym J.L. Reasoner together with his wife.
James Reasoner used the pseudonym Dana Fuller Ross.
Most of James Reasoner's books were written as part of existing Western fiction series.
Many of Reasoner's pseudonyms were publishing 'house' names that other authors who contributed to those series may also have used.
